create_HorizontalBoxes_from_tensor: create HorizontalBoxes from a PyTorch tensor with xyxy coordinates and optional cxcywh input mode
convert_cxcywh_to_xyxy: convert box coordinates from center-width-height format to top-left bottom-right xyxy format
flip_translate_clip_boxes: flip boxes horizontally or vertically, translate by distances, or clip to image boundaries in-place
rotate_project_boxes: rotate boxes around a center point by angle or project with a homography matrix in-place
calculate_box_overlaps: calculate IoU or IoF overlap between two sets of boxes using the overlaps static method
